summary: Full backend + frontend E2E testing of ARIADNI ID. 14/14 backend pytest tests passed (public card GET, 404, vcard, QR PNG, auth login/me/401, admin CRUD, duplicate slug 400, image upload+download, admin 401 without token). Frontend public profile /feras-askar renders Beige Luxury template with ALL required data-testids present. Admin flow: /admin redirects to /login when unauthenticated, login works, card list shows card-item-feras-askar, new-card-button opens editor with editor-preview + admin-save-button, editing existing card via edit-feras-askar shows editor-template (shadcn Select) that updates the live preview instantly when switched (verified Beige Luxury -> Executive Black Gold).

issues: Empty profile photo src warning in console: 'An empty string ("") was passed to the src attribute' + 404 for empty image URL when creating a blank new card. Cosmetic only; render conditionally when profilePhoto is empty.

action_items: (Low priority) In TemplateRenderer/preview, avoid rendering when identity.profilePhoto is empty to remove console warning + 404 on new card creation.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py PUBLIC_APP_URL taken from env at import time; QR encodes this URL - correctly configured.
startup() re-hashes admin password if changed - good idempotent seed.
verify_password used to compare plaintext admin password each startup; acceptable but slightly costly.
All admin endpoints properly gated by get_current_user; MongoDB _id excluded via projection - good.

CORS allow_origins uses '*' with allow_credentials=True which browsers reject for credentialed requests; app uses Bearer token (not cookies) so not a functional issue, but flag for future cookie-based auth.
seed_data_creation: None - used existing seeded demo card (feras-askar). CRUD test creates+deletes a throwaway card each run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers auth, public card, vcard, QR PNG bytes, admin CRUD, duplicate slug 400, upload+download roundtrip via emergent object storage. editor-template is a shadcn Select (BUTTON with role=combobox), not native <select> - open then click role=option.
